FN-R9QWMYM-1
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 125
Committee: Boards, Agencies and Sponsor: Representative Margie Wilcox
Commissions
Analyst: Tiffany Weaver Date: 02/07/2025
House Bill 125 as introduced provides for the continuance of the Alabama State Board of
Veterinary Medical Examiners until October 1, 2027 pursuant to the Alabama Sunset Law. This
bill will not otherwise affect state or local funding.
